name: tcp-reset-mid-handshake
description: Every TCP connection to the relay's address completes its three-way handshake and is then reset — toward both ends — on the first packet that carries data, whatever that data is. Not keyed on a name: another SNI to the same address dies the same way. UDP is untouched, so the QUIC families survive.
analogue: RST injection against an address already suspected of being a proxy (censor-lab's tcp-reset-mid-handshake; the 20 August 2025 incident in which every TCP/443 connection across China was reset for 74 minutes). Model: address-keyed, first data packet, one reset each way, in-path. No residual timer, no probabilistic behaviour.
